defect_summary: Prep was committed on local release/v0.7.0 and git push of that ref was rejected by ruleset 25824126. Recurrence of the 2026-10-31 PUSH_FAST_FORWARD defect.
unsuitable_process: The planner still chooses PUSH_FAST_FORWARD (git push of release/v*) when the local release branch is ahead. The 2026-10-31 preventive action was not implemented. Ruleset 25824126 requires a pull request and fitness before those commits may move the ref.
climb_steps: git push origin release/v0.7.0 was rejected.
PUSH_FAST_FORWARD in execute.sh is still git push of the release branch.
2026-10-31 RCA named this and was not implemented.
docs/github-ruleset-release.md forbids producer push of release/* as first publication.

repo_touch.belief: ADR 0025 — defects name unsuitable process, not agents
